content_text: The five-day workshop was part of a new series launched by Getty to introduce undergraduate HBCU students to conservation as a potential career path. While engaging with the JPC archive, students from a variety of disciplines learn the principles of photograph conservation — how to identify photographic processes, assess the condition of photographs, and perform entry-level treatments such as surface cleaning, all under the guidance of expert photograph conservators.
